items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Robert La Gamma invited us to Thanksgiving dinner along with Monsieur and Madame Pango the 25th.

ctx.x: We rehearsed the morning and afternoon of the 23rd, also the morning of the 24th and played the first concert that night at the University of Abidjan. It was the rainy season in the Ivory Coast and that day, about 4 p.m., a storm started. Usually, it finished in an hour or two, but that day, we couldn't see the end of it. The concert was open air and we really thought that we wouldn't be able to play. But about 8 p.m., the rain almost stopped, and we left for the university.
Robert La Gamma invited us to Thanksgiving dinner along with Monsieur and Madame Pango the 25th.

The 26th, we were invited to the residence of Mr. and Mrs.Root, the American Ambassador, who was giving a luncheon in our honour. This was a different reception from the kick in the ass I got when I was in Egypt, and couldn't even get a look at the Ambassador when the fellows I was with and myself needed help. We gave a concert that night at the cultural center in Treichville and Mr Root came and had a ball.
